column2: 4. The objects of the body corporate shall be carried out
in accordance with written law and in such manner so as not
to create any conflict between the work of the body corporate
and  any  work  being  carried  out  simultaneously  by  any
Ministry  or  Department  of  the  Government  or  of  any
Provincial Council or any Local Authority.
